root_causes.detail: Owner rotation continued before the global nonprogress hard cap. It reset local stagnation even though no verifier-backed progress occurred, allowing all ten rounds to run.

Verifier owner resolution considered PM/CE/JobToken paths but ignored successful durable TaskRuntime effect receipts. A file physically created by TASK-2 was therefore projected as owner_unknown and repeatedly deferred.

The repair classifier compared deduplicated diagnostic signatures. One newly introduced common exception collapsed 21 unittest errors into one normalized signature, so a severe 4 failures -> 1 failure + 21 errors regression was incorrectly accepted as progress.

The deterministic no-commit cache used the full verifier signature including volatile traceback/source line numbers. A physical LLM edit that only shifted lines made the same diagnostic look new and reopened the same no-effect deterministic schedule.

The no-mutation branch checked the global nonprogress fuse before owner rotation, but the physical-mutation branch checked it afterward. Equal-count-swap edits therefore continued through owner-rotation before the hard cap could stop the retry.
